description: World - Regulatory Indicators for Sustainable Energy is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Carlos Andres Guadarrama Gandara (World Bank Group). Regulatory Indicators for Sustainable Energy (RISE) is a policy scorecard assessing the investment climate for sustainable energy and focusing on three key areas: energy access, energy efficiency and renewable energy. RISE covers 111 countries across the developed and developing worlds, which together represent over 90% of global population, GDP and energy consumption. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in XLSX. The portal files it under Policies and plans, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
